config.serverUrl.description: beilu-always-accompany backend URL (default aligns with src/constants.ts DEFAULT_SERVER_URL; change port in both places)
config.hints.enabled.description: Master switch for diagnostic hints (_hint) attached to tool results for AI. When off, no hint text is appended
config.hints.overrides.description: Override hint text by key (see src/services/hintTexts.ts HINT_TEXTS for key list; keep placeholders like {n}/{error})
config.autoConnect.description: Automatically connect to backend on startup
config.autoStartWs.description: Automatically start IDE Bridge WebSocket server on startup
config.wsPort.description: IDE Bridge WebSocket server port (frontend ideConnPanel connects to this port; default aligns with src/constants.ts DEFAULT_WS_PORT)
config.sandboxMode.description: Sandbox mode: connect to sandbox instance (13140) instead of production instance (1314), for testing new features
config.sandboxServerUrl.description: beilu backend URL in sandbox mode (default aligns with src/constants.ts DEFAULT_SANDBOX_SERVER_URL)
config.sandboxWsPort.description: IDE Bridge WS port in sandbox mode (default aligns with src/constants.ts DEFAULT_SANDBOX_WS_PORT)
config.maxFileReferences.description: Max number of @file references per message (excess truncated; 0 or negative = unlimited)
config.autoRevealOnEdit.description: Automatically open editor and jump to highlighted modified line after AI edits a file (EditorReveal has always read this key, previously undeclared in settings panel)
